definitions.gloss: carrying in one's arms, holding (a child or pet)
definitions.explanation: Holding someone (especially a child or pet) in one's arms, typically facing the holder. A fundamental childcare word.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんをだっこする。
examples.english: To hold a baby in one's arms.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}をだっこしたら{引|ひ}っ{掻|か}かれた。
examples.english: When I held the cat, it scratched me.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {抱|だ}っこ.

USAGE: Functions as a noun and as a する verb (だっこする).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- だっこする (to hold in one's arms)
- だっこしてもらう (to be held)
- だっこ{紐|ひも} (baby carrier)

RELATED WORDS: おんぶ (piggyback, carrying on back), {抱|だ}きしめる (to hug tightly), {抱|だ}く (to hold, embrace - more formal).

NOTE: Children often request だっこ when they want to be picked up and carried.
